d:
Who made the BEST non-goalie save of last season? We asked NHL players — including goaltenders — to watch, react to and ultimately choose their favorite among eight incredible skater saves!
Matthew Schaefer, David Pastrnak, Quinn Hughes, Jaccob Slavin, Jamie Drysdale, Jake Sanderson, Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen, Philipp Grubauer and Lukas Dostal break down some of the most unbelievable defensive plays of the season!
